implementation.transaction_order: existing authorization revisions -> business object lock -> task identity lock -> River row lock -> current semantic version/state check -> business retry + official JobRetryTx -> sf_tasks cancellation-intent reset -> metadata cancellation-key deletion and operation revision increment -> audit and commit
implementation.metadata: Read the latest locked River row into map[string]json.RawMessage, remove only cancel_attempted_at, advance sf_operation_revision, then use official JobUpdateFull with only MetadataDoUpdate enabled. Cancellation retains its existing official merge operation.

implementation.driver_semantics: Both JobRetry implementations retain metadata. SQLite JobUpdate uses JSON merge patch and removes a null-valued supplied key; PostgreSQL JobUpdate concatenates JSONB and retains a null-valued key, while cancellation tests key presence. Locked full metadata replacement expresses deletion consistently.
implementation.concurrency: Retry stays unavailable while the cancelled worker still owns a running attempt. Tests overlap cancellation with the original worker snooze or second step commit, require premature retry409, then retry the finalized cancellation. Concurrent HTTP retries produce one200 and one409 with one retry audit and one operation revision increment.
implementation.rollback: An injected task.retry audit failure restores the prior cancellation timestamp, metadata, sf_tasks cancellation intent, business document and semantic version; retry can then use the same confirmed version after removing the injected failure.
